Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You bend the first poles into place while your companions gather around the promise of a dry night.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Time
One hour per crafting attempt.
Target / range / shape
A chosen campsite and available ordinary materials; one hour per attempt.
Duration
Until dismantled or damaged; packing requires ten minutes.
Equipment / acquisition
Craft tools, Bulk 1, if absent. The recipe is known on learning this card; no materials granted.
Limits
This card crafts only its Camp Shelter recipe. Extreme weather and hostile attack can damage the shelter; DA states visible limitations before construction.
Type
Skill / Crafting / Utility

Build a temporary shelter for yourself and up to six companions. This card grants the reusable Camp Shelter recipe; use its target 4, materials, tools and one-hour attempt time. On completion it shelters the occupants from ordinary rain and wind; it is not fortification. No group crafting.

Weak
1 construction progress; identify any unsuitable material before consuming it.
Standard
2 construction progress and the same material check.
Strong
3 construction progress and the same material check; if this result completes the shelter, it can be packed for reuse as one Bulk 1 bundle under the recipe’s rules.

Source: design/cards/a-roof-before-nightfall.md at bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809.
